I, Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands do hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the land described below is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

The allotments of land described below, depicted in Surveyor General’s Advance Tracing No. Ma/LGG/2018/441 of 14.06.2019 situated at Dewaladeniya (Topo P.P.20) Village in, Gangala Udasiya Pattuwa Minor Division of Laggala Pallegama Divisional Secretary’s Division, Matale District, Central Province and bounded as follows:

01. Lot ‘A’ – Wattakkayaya and Bathalayaya – Extent: 3.4231 Hectares North: Wattakkayaya and Bathalayaya claimed by Konara Mudiyanselage Watte Gedara Wajira Chanaka and Ma Oya; East: Mathuwagala claimant not known and Mathuwagala claimed by W. G. Nimal Karunarathna; South: Mathuwagala claimed by W. G. Nimal Karunarathna, Lot B and Wattakkayaya and Bathalayaya claimed by Pahala

Gedara Sirisoma; West: Wattakkayaya and Bathalayaya claimed by Konara Mudiyanselage Lalith Wasantha Konara and Wattakkayaya and Bathalayaya claimed by Konara Mudiyanselage Watte Gedara Wajira Chanaka.

02. Lot ‘B’ – Wattakkayaya and Bathalayaya – Extent: 2.2983 Hectares North: Wattakkayaya and Bathalayaya claimed by Konara Mudiyanselage Lalith Wasantha Konara and Lot A; East: Mathuwagala claimed by W. G. Nimal Karunarathna; South: Mathuwagala claimed by W. G. Nimal Karunarathna and Wattakkayaya and Bathalayaya claimed by K. M. Heenbanda; West: Wattakkayaya and Bathalayaya claimed by Pahala Gedara Sirisoma.
Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands.
My No.: LD/05/2010/MV/52 B.Ministry of Tourism and Lands,“Mihikatha Medura”, No. 1200/6, Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla.10th October, 2023.
